User-supplied models — October 12, 2026

The user supplied three FBX prop collections, stated that they made these props,
and authorized separation, editing, resizing and use in this jewelry-store project.
No public-domain or Creative Commons license was asserted.
These files remain subject to the creator's rights; this notice does not grant
an independent license for unrelated redistribution.

Prepared in Blender 5.2 with Tools/prepare_user_props.py. Original FBX files and
editable Blender intermediates are preserved in ReferenceAssets/UserProps.
Eight exports use metre units, floor pivots and intentionally plain materials.
